title: Navan Edge vs. Instinct: Which one handles business travel better?
summary: Compare Navan Edge and Instinct for business-trip booking, loyalty, repeat trips, itinerary changes, human help, access, and cost. Choose the right AI assistant.
body_markdown:
An AI travel agent should work beyond a booking confirmation. It should also remember that you prefer morning flights, hotels with a 24 hour gym, and authentic Italian restaurants. It should keep your loyalty status in view, and be able to help if and when plans change for any reason.


Instinct can handle travel alongside other daily tasks. Navan Edge is purposely built for business trips, from searching live inventory to managing changes if plans go sideways. That distinction matters even more if you frequently travel for work.


In this guide we’ll compare how Navan Edge and Instinct handle search and booking, loyalty, itinerary changes, human support, and pricing so you can decide which one fits the way you travel for work.


### Key takeaways


- For frequent, self-managed work travel, Navan Edge as a dedicate AI travel agent is the stronger choice.
- Instinct is better suited to someone who wants a general assistant that can also arrange a trip.
- Booking is not the real differentiator because both assistants can act on travel requests. The difference becomes clearer over repeat trips, loyalty decisions, and handling itinerary changes.
- Navan Edge’s combination of AI and human travel experts means your business trip is in the best possible hands, 24/7.


## What’s the verdict on Navan Edge vs. Instinct?


For recurring work travel, Navan Edge is the better fit. For a personal assistant that can also take on travel, Instinct might be your preference.


[Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) is an AI travel agent specifically for business travel. You can book flights, hotels and restaurants through a single chat, with options shaped by your preferences and real-time inventory. For this comparison, that matters because travel is the whole focus, rather than a task on a wider list.


With Instinct you can do things like, ask it to follow up on an email, arrange an airport ride, or take an action on a connected service. Travel is a credible part of that experience, but not its sole purpose.\[1\]\[2\]


## What can Navan Edge and Instinct actually do?


Both assistants can handle with travel, but they approach the job from different directions.


**Navan Edge**


**Instinct**


Core job


Navan Edge focuses on individual business travel, from the first search through changes on the road.


Instinct is a general personal assistant that can use connected apps, services, and devices to carry out a request.\[1\]


Travel booking


Navan Edge searches live flight and hotel inventory and can complete the booking in chat.


Instinct can book or change travel through connected providers in a text or voice conversation.\[2\]\[3\]


Dining


Navan Edge can use a trip’s location, timing, and dining preferences to find and book restaurants


Instinct can make restaurant reservations via chat or its calling feature.\[5\]


Loyalty and rewards


Loyalty Wallet connects all points and miles in one place, and search results can surface the most rewarding stays. In addition to loyalty rewards and credit card points, you can earn 5% Amazon Gift Card on eligible hotel stays\[6\]


Instinct does not currently advertise a travel-loyalty wallet or rewards program.\[1\]\[2\]


When plans change


Navan Edge can manage itinerary changes in chat and bring in a human travel expert who already has the trip context.


Instinct can be used to rebook travel, apply credits, monitor fares, and preserve seat assignments through connected providers.\[2\]\[3\]


Human help


A human travel agent can join the conversation 24/7 when the request needs judgment or special handling.


Instinct does not currently advertise a dedicated 24/7 human travel-agent service.\[1\]\[2\]


Access and price


Navan Edge is free, requires no credit card for sign up, and is available on the web and iPhone.


Instinct is currently invite only/ private beta; no public consumer price is listed.


If travel is one task among many, Instinct’s breadth is attractive. If work trips repeat often enough to develop patterns and status goals, Navan Edge as a specialized platform is more suitable.

## How does each assistant handle a real work trip?


Imagine you need to be in Chicago for a board meeting at 9 a.m. Wednesday. You want a nonstop flight Tuesday morning, an aisle seat near the front, a quiet hotel within a short walk of the meeting, and dinner for three somewhere your vegetarian client will genuinely enjoy.


With Navan Edge, that can begin as one conversational request. It can search real-time flight and hotel inventory, take your seat and property preferences into account, and use the trip location and timing to help with dinner reservations. You review the options and explicitly approve each booking. Flight, hotel, dining, and itinerary stay in one app, and connected loyalty programs inform the options that are surfaced so you can book the most rewarding flights and hotel stays.


Instinct can approach the same request as a series of connected actions. It interacts with third-party websites and apps on your behalf to handle booking, rebooking, fare monitoring, airline credits, and seat assignments through a text or voice conversation.\[2\]\[3\] The outcome however, still depends on the provider.


## Which assistant works better for frequent business travel?


A first booking highlights whether an assistant can actually handle the trip. Repeated travel reveals how personal the travel assistant actually is. Navan Edge can use preferences shared in chat, booking history, and connected loyalty programs to shape future options. That is the practical value of an[AI assistant for business travel](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-use-ai-for-business-travel) : the context is attached to live travel choices and can influence the next booking.


Instinct can also draw on previous context, and connect to email, calendars, messaging and other . Those connections give it context beyond the trip, which is useful when a calendar change also creates messages, purchases, or other follow-up tasks.\[1\]\[4\]


The practical choice is whether you want one assistant to follow many tasks, or a dedicated AI travel agent that can make the right tradeoffs as a frequent business traveller. For example, Navan Edge will know if you prefer a more expensive flight that saves a layover, will display the potential loyalty earnings with each result it surfaces, and the overall experience is tailored to travel, without being influenced by so much other context that Instinct gets from other conversations.


## How do Navan Edge and Instinct handle loyalty and rewards?


Loyalty should shape the options you see, not become something you check after booking. A flight or hotel may cost slightly more but still be the better choice if it earns points with a preferred program or moves you closer to a certain status.


Navan Edge’s Loyalty Wallet brings your connected airline and hotel programs together, showing your status and points balances, so you can track your progress toward the next tier in one place. It uses those programs to personalize flight and hotel recommendations and show what you’ll earn on each stay, helping you identify the most rewarding options for your trip.


For someone juggling several accounts, that makes[managing multiple loyalty programs](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-manage-multiple-loyalty-programs) much easier, and therefore more rewarding as a result. Plus, in addition to miles and points, you can earn 5% in Amazon Gift Cards on eligible hotel stays booked through Navan Edge.


Instinct can take action through connected services, but it does not currently advertise a travel-loyalty wallet or rewards program.\[1\]\[2\]


## What happens when your itinerary changes?


Now imagine that the Chicago meeting moves to Thursday after your flight and hotel are booked. This is where you see the quality of a travel assistant.


With Navan Edge, you explain the situation in the same chat you booked the original trip. The assistant can[work through the itinerary change](https://investors.navan.com/static-files/3a56a8dc-02a3-4016-a89d-a0ea81212edc) , and a human travel expert can join the chat on request if you need some extra judgment, with no need to explain the situation over again. You approve any change before it is completed.


[A travel concierge](https://navan.com/blog/edge/travel-concierge) matters when a request does not fit neatly into a filter. A late check-in, unusual room request, or disrupted connection may need someone to weigh the options and resolve the exception.


Instinct can rebook travel, email a hotel on your behalf, monitor fares, apply credits, and preserve seat assignments through connected providers, however the provider’s pricing, cancellation, and refund rules still apply.\[2\]\[3\]


If the reason for the itinerary change is a disruption, there is no human support if needed through Instinct. If you find yourself stranded due to an unexpected layover at 3am after a stressful week, this might be just the kind of support that you prefer.


## Should you choose Navan Edge or Instinct for business travel?


For traveler's managing recurring work trips, Navan Edge wins this comparison. The chat is only the front end — behind it sits Navan’s travel infrastructure, live flight and hotel inventory, supplier connections, booking and servicing capabilities, trip data, and 24/7 human travel agents.


That operation allows Navan Edge to do more than build an itinerary. If a request needs judgment or special handling, having a human on hand at any given moment is extremely valuable and comforting.


This becomes even more valuable over time. Navan Edge can account for the routes you repeat, the loyalty programs you use, and the seat and hotel details you care about without treating every trip like the first one.


Instinct makes more sense if you want the same assistant to handle general personal admin. For recurring business travel where loyalty and status matter, Navan Edge’s dedicated travel operation has the advantage.\[1\]\[3\]
